mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply-side disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5%) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS < 0%) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS < 0% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY during a late-cycle expansion signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY during late-cycle expansion and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%) and tightening monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4%) signals a restrictive economic environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, the hypothesis fails.
